title: History
explicit: Explicit IDs are listed in the target pages below.
interrupted: Execution was interrupted. Resume checks and processes only targets that were never sent.
ambiguous: Some write outcomes are uncertain. Inspect Paperless manually. These targets will not be retried and are not rollback candidates.
provenance: Confirmed write; eligible for rollback review.
noProvenance: No confirmed write provenance. No automatic rollback.
noRollback: Only proven Job writes can be restored. Conflicts and unknown outcomes require manual review.
uncertainApply: The Job creation response was lost. A Job may already exist. Check History before starting another preview.
race: Custom-field writes replace the complete collection. Pause other applications that write to Paperless; concurrent external edits can be lost.
acknowledgeRace: I understand that concurrent external custom-field edits can be lost.
